newsitem.title: BURMA: Lao premier to visit Burma, discuss ASEAN.
newsitem.headline: Lao premier to visit Burma, discuss ASEAN.

text.p: Laotian Prime Minister Khamtay Siphandone will visit Burma soon, official media reported on Wednesday.
Although no dates were given, such high-level visits usually take place within a few days of their announcement.

The premier was expected to meet chairman of Burma's ruling State Law and Order Restoration Council General Than Shwe to discuss the two countries' pending entry into the seven-member Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), analysts said.

Foreign ministers of ASEAN, which comprises Brunei, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand and Vietnam, were set to hold a meeting in July to discuss the admission of new members including Burma, Laos and Cambodia.
